description: Add a wiki-link from one note to another with a context sentence describing why they're connected. Appends the link to the source note and records the edge in the graph so analytics pick it up.

context.description: One-sentence explanation of why these notes are connected.

dryRun.description: If true, return the line that would be appended without writing.

source.description: Source note to add the link from (path or fuzzy match).

target.description: Target note to link to (path, title, or new wiki-link ref).

name: link_notes
